factors.name: volatility_gate
factors.explanation: Computes the percentage change in close price over one day, gated by the z-score of volume over 10 days. The gate filters for abnormally high volume, aligning with the hypothesis mechanism.

factors.name: ranked_volume
factors.explanation: Ranks the product of one-day close price change and the z-score of volume over 10 days. Combines both signals into a cross-sectional ranking.

factors.name: volume_condition
factors.explanation: Computes the difference between sum of high-volume days and mean volume, scaled by one-day close change. Captures abnormal volume as a conditional signal.

factors.name: zscore_volume
factors.explanation: Standardizes the product of volume z-score and close price change. Standardization enhances comparability across stocks.

factors.name: volume_rank
factors.explanation: Ranks the product of volume z-score and close price change. Provides a cross-sectional measure of the hypothesis mechanism.

factors.name: conditional_rank
factors.explanation: Ranks one-day close change only when volume z-score exceeds 2, applying a conditional gate to filter abnormally high-volume days.

factors.name: vol_reversal_zscore
factors.explanation: This gates extreme volume z-scores and standardizes them across the cross-section. It serves the conditional regime detection and normalization.

factors.name: vol_reversal_diff
factors.explanation: This contrasts the ranked change in volume with the ranked change in return, capturing the relative reversal signal. It serves the cross-sectional comparison mechanism.

factors.name: vol_reversal_corr
factors.explanation: This measures the correlation between 3-day volume changes and 1-day returns, capturing the statistical relationship implied by the hypothesis. It serves the regression-based mechanism.

factors.name: vol_reversal_quantile
factors.explanation: This subtracts the lower quantile of returns from the upper quantile of volume changes, highlighting the reversal pattern. It serves the quantile-based comparison mechanism.
